weaknesses.title: No in-place numeric field mutate — debit is STR+REPLACEALL+SETMATCH rebuild
weaknesses.detail: Budgets stored as name:N cannot N-- in place. Agents must AFTER, NUM, arithmetic, STR, template rebuild, SETMATCH. Race-prone multi-step; no atomic debit form.
weaknesses.repro: debit api 2: find api:10 → build api:8 → SETMATCH

weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE cannot tally zero budgets by suffix
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE bag ':0' → 0 even when mesh:0 exists. Zero-count requires EACH LINE + AFTER + NUM + CMP 0. GREP ':0' works for exact :0 but still substring-risky for :01 etc.

weaknesses.title: SYS NUM only parses LAST — amount/remaining need PREPEND/HEAD or AFTER shuttle
weaknesses.detail: Cannot SYS NUM amount_var directly from named string without landing value in LAST. Debit amount ARG must PREPEND "" AMT_S; HEAD; NUM.
weaknesses.repro: forms: SYS NUM uses LAST only

weaknesses.title: GREP bare name matches name_v2 cousins
weaknesses.detail: GREP 'api' keeps api:8 and api_v2:5. Identity requires BEFORE ':' + EQS name.

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH first-only leaves duplicate budget residuals
weaknesses.detail: Two api:1 fields → one SETMATCH leaves residual api:1. No SETMATCHALL; double-seed corrupts ledger.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line budget bags
weaknesses.detail: list bag dumps as db:0api:8mesh:3api_v2:5 — unparseable. Prefer sum_rem/n_zero scalars + plate file.

weaknesses.title: WRITE bag often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A shows last name:N without $. Shell tools see incomplete last line.

weaknesses.title: SYS PUSH bag line result must be re-bound with LET bag = LAST every time
weaknesses.detail: Missed LET report = LAST after PUSH of miss value silently dropped the field. Accumulate pattern is error-prone; no bag-append that mutates named var in place.
weaknesses.repro: PUSH report val without LET report=LAST → next PUSH uses stale bag

weaknesses.title: PRINT of LAST when LAST is string "0" can look like 1
weaknesses.detail: PRINT LAST after SYS STR 0 printed '1' while PRINT_JSON correctly shows LAST=0. Agents debugging zero budgets with PRINT alone get false friends; prefer PRINT_JSON.
weaknesses.repro: SYS STR 0; PRINT LAST → 1; PRINT_JSON LAST → {"LAST":"0"}

workarounds: Identity: BEFORE ':' + EQS — not GREP name
Amount parse: PREPEND empty + HEAD + NUM shuttle
Always LET bag = LAST after every PUSH/SETMATCH/MOVELINE/REMOVELINE
PRINT_JSON for zero-ish scalars; avoid bare PRINT LAST for "0"
Credit ceiling: SYS MIN / SYS CLAMP with CUBALC_BUDGET_MAX
language_gaps: Atomic bag field numeric debit/credit (or SETMATCH with expr)
COUNTLINE suffix / field-pattern tally for :N classes
In-place bag PUSH into named var (auto-bind)
SYS NUM from named string without LAST shuttle
PRINT_JSON newline escape; WRITE force trailing NL
PRINT of string "0" should not look truthy/confusing
issues_faced: Forgot LET report=LAST after PUSH miss value — report missing miss field until fixed
PRINT LAST after STR 0 printed 1 — misleading for zero remaining debug
Post-tally EACH overwrites remaining with last row (report remaining not always action remaining)
